name: rondel
description: Retrospective and meeting tool: static app, end-to-end encrypted sync through a tiny room server (Node or Cloudflare) or peer-to-peer

scripts.lab:deploy: npm run build && node scripts/site-config.mjs deploy/spikinglabs/lab.json && wrangler deploy -c deploy/spikinglabs/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.lab:staging: npm run build && node scripts/site-config.mjs deploy/spikinglabs/staging.json && wrangler deploy -c deploy/spikinglabs/wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.lab:check-staging: export BASE_URL=https://rondel-staging.spikinglabs.workers.dev/ && node --import tsx e2e/server.mjs && node --import tsx e2e/lab.mjs
scripts.lab:check-live: export BASE_URL=https://rondel.lab.spikinglabs.com/ && node --import tsx e2e/server.mjs && node --import tsx e2e/lab.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: node e2e/smoke.mjs && node --import tsx e2e/server.mjs && node --import tsx e2e/series.mjs && node --import tsx e2e/data.mjs && node --import tsx e2e/lab.mjs && node --import tsx e2e/site.mjs && node --import tsx e2e/languages.mjs && node e2e/artifact.mjs && node --import tsx e2e/mobile.mjs
